    Socle reduction to a string algebra #

    This file isolates the axiom-free numerical consequence of the structural socle-reduction theorem. It selects all nonuniserial indecomposable projective-injective right modules, rejects their socles simultaneously, and uses a supplied string presentation of the quotient to force vanishing of the ambient Auslander--Reiten surplus.

    Finset S.ProjectiveLabel

    The canonical finite family of indecomposable projective-injective right modules which are not uniserial.

      If the canonical simultaneous socle quotient is a string algebra, then the original module category has zero Auslander--Reiten surplus. This is the axiom-free consequence consumed by the final converse.
